$comment: Pinned external-codebase corpus for the language false-positive dogfood. Mirrors the per-language T3 FP acceptance run (council §16.5 #9). Commits are PINNED so re-runs are deterministic; bump a sha deliberately and note it in the evidence writeup. See README.md.
fp_bar: council §16.5 #9 — genuine-FP rate on the default (non-opt-in) catalogue; RSTLAN-008 set the precedent at 0%.

repos.name: ripgrep
repos.why: Idiomatic, carefully-written CLI baseline. Stresses the build.rs / tests.rs RS-001/RS-002 exclusions on an external test layout.

repos.name: tokio
repos.why: Heavy, well-documented `// SAFETY:` unsafe and macro-generated code. Adversarial for RS-003 (must NOT fire on documented unsafe) and for parse robustness.

repos.name: alacritty
repos.why: FFI/rendering unsafe + serde config structs + build scripts. Stresses RS-003, the opt-in RS-004, and re-validates the build.rs exclusion on a foreign tree.

repos.name: zod
repos.why: Adversarial for the Zod rules AP-015/AP-016 (same spirit as rich->PY-006). Type machinery uses `any` definitionally -> AP-003 / GS-001 FP stress.

repos.name: vite
repos.why: Large real-world TS tooling. Bundler codegen -> AP-008 (eval) / AP-009 (new Function) FP risk; broad eslint-disable usage -> AP-001 / AP-002.

repos.name: excalidraw
repos.why: Large React+TS application. Real-world @ts-ignore / any / non-null assertions at app scale -> AP-003 / AP-004 / GS-001; exercises string/comment masking on a big tree.
